quarters.supplementaryReportName: Q3 2024 Supplementary Regulatory Capital Disclosure (figures corroborated via Q4 2024 press release comparatives)

notes.tier1CapitalRatio: Tier 1 capital ratio %, BMO Q3 2024 Report to Shareholders capital table (Q3-2024).
notes.totalCapitalRatio: Total capital ratio %, BMO Q3 2024 Report to Shareholders capital table (Q3-2024).
notes.tlacRatio: risk-based TLAC ratio; TLAC leverage ratio was 8.2% (not included as separate field)
notes.lcr: Average daily LCR for the quarter ended July 31, 2024 = 129%, BMO Q3 2024 Report to Shareholders Liquidity and Funding Risk section.
notes.nsfr: NSFR = 116% as at July 31, 2024, BMO Q3 2024 Report to Shareholders Liquidity and Funding Risk section.
notes.roe: reported ROE used (10.0%); adjusted ROE was 10.6%
notes.efficiencyRatio: adjusted efficiency ratio (57.3%); reported efficiency ratio not found in accessible sources
notes.loansToAssetsPct: Computed: net loans and acceptances ($673,719M) ÷ total assets ($1,400,470M) as at July 31, 2024, from the BMO Q3 2024 Report to Shareholders Consolidated Balance Sheet. (Note: the total-assets figure shown elsewhere in this dataset for Q3 2024 appears to be a prior data-entry error; this ratio uses the balance-sheet figures from BMO's own Q3 2024 report.)
notes.retailDepositsPct: Individuals (personal) deposits $328,380M ÷ total deposits $965,239M, from the BMO Q3 2024 Report to Shareholders Deposits note + balance sheet.
notes.wholesaleDepositsPct: Bank ($29,596M) + Business & government ($607,263M) deposits ÷ total deposits $965,239M, BMO Q3 2024 Report to Shareholders Deposits note. (Any remainder to 100% is deposits at FVTPL, not classified by depositor type.)
notes.loanToDepositRatio: Gross loans and acceptances $677,995M ÷ total deposits $965,239M, BMO Q3 2024 Report to Shareholders balance sheet.
notes.irrbbEveSensitivityPct: Most adverse of BMO's two disclosed shocks (+100bp / -100bp parallel) Economic Value Sensitivity, Total = $-1629M, ÷ Tier 1 capital $63,598M = -2.56%. From the Structural Interest Rate Sensitivity table in the BMO Q3 2024 Report to Shareholders — BMO discloses this quarterly (not only annually). Normalized to % of Tier 1 capital for cross-bank comparability.
notes.irrbbNiiSensitivityPct: Most adverse of BMO's two disclosed shocks Earnings (12-month NII) Sensitivity, Total = $-294M, ÷ Tier 1 capital $63,598M = -0.46%. Structural Interest Rate Sensitivity table, BMO Q3 2024 Report to Shareholders (quarterly disclosure). Normalized to % of Tier 1 capital to match the RBC/TD/CIBC/National convention.
notes.stableDepositsPct: Stable deposits $138M as a share of total retail and small-business deposits $296M ($138M stable + $158M less stable). Denominator is the retail and small-business book, so this bucket and less stable deposits sum to 100%.
notes.lessStableDepositsPct: Less stable deposits $158M as a share of total retail and small-business deposits $296M ($138M stable + $158M less stable). Denominator is the retail and small-business book, so this bucket and stable deposits sum to 100%.
notes.operationalDepositsPct: Operational deposits $146M as a share of total wholesale deposits $280M ($146M operational + $134M non-operational). Denominator is the wholesale book, so this bucket and non-operational deposits sum to 100%.
notes.nonOperationalDepositsPct: Non-operational deposits $134M as a share of total wholesale deposits $280M ($146M operational + $134M non-operational). Denominator is the wholesale book, so this bucket and operational deposits sum to 100%.
notes.wholesaleFundingPct: BMO's own disclosed "Total secured and unsecured wholesale funding outstanding" of $257.3 billion (Q3 2024 Report to Shareholders, Liquidity and Funding Risk narrative) ÷ total assets $1440.3 billion = 17.86%. Same scope as BMO's annual figure: excludes repo transactions and bankers' acceptances. BMO discloses this headline figure every quarter.
notes.tlacLeverageRatio: TLAC as a percentage of leverage ratio exposure, per OSFI's TLAC guideline. Cross-checked against an overlapping supplementary/Pillar 3 disclosure.
notes.dividendPayoutRatio: Reported basis, from BMO's Supplementary Financial Information (line 23). BMO also publishes an adjusted payout ratio on line 24, which differs materially in some quarters.
notes.roa: Disclosed by the issuer: 0.54% return on average assets, read from the supplementary financial information (page 7), in the column headed Q3 2024. Not computed.
notes.adjustedOperatingLeverage: Disclosed: +5.2% adjusted operating leverage, read from the issuer's Q2 2026 financial supplementary information (page 7) in the column headed Q3 2024. Operating leverage is the difference between revenue growth and expense growth, so positive means revenue grew faster than costs.
notes.rotce: Disclosed: 13.9% return on tangible common equity (reported basis, not the adjusted row), read from page 7 of the cited document in the column for Q3 2024. ROTCE is net income available to common shareholders over average common equity less goodwill and intangibles.
notes.equityMultiplier: Computed from two disclosed figures: average total assets $1,385,866M divided by average common equity $72,305M = 19.17x. Both operands are published in the issuer's own financial supplementary information. Average COMMON equity is the denominator so the DuPont identity holds against the ROE and ROA already in this dataset (ROA x multiplier is approximately ROE).

quarters.supplementaryReportName: Q4 2024 Capital and Liquidity Measures table (within earnings release)

notes.roe: reported ROE used (11.4%); adjusted ROE was notably lower (7.4%) this quarter due to a large positive one-time item (reversal of a prior legal provision) boosting reported income above adjusted income
notes.efficiencyRatio: reported efficiency ratio (49.4%), unusually low this quarter due to the same one-time reported-income boost; adjusted efficiency ratio was 58.3%
notes.loansToAssetsPct: Computed: net loans and acceptances at Oct 31 2024 ($678,375M, from the BMO Q1 2025 Report to Shareholders balance sheet prior-year-end column) ÷ total assets ($1,409,647M).
notes.loanToDepositRatio: Computed: gross loans $682,372mm (Table 26, Net Loans) ÷ total deposits $982,440mm (Table 27, Deposits), both as at Oct 31, 2024. Not a figure BMO discloses directly as a ratio.
notes.wholesaleFundingPct: BMO's own disclosed 'Total secured and unsecured wholesale funding outstanding' of $255,511mm (Table 53, Wholesale Funding Maturities) ÷ total assets $1,409,647mm. Scope note: BMO explicitly states this figure excludes repo transactions and bankers' acceptances. It includes interbank deposits, CP/CD, bearer deposit notes, ABCP, senior unsecured MTNs/structured notes, mortgage/HELOC securitizations, covered bonds, other ABS, FHLB advances, and subordinated debt. Including repo ($110,791mm) per the broader task definition raises this to ~25.99% — the narrower, BMO-defined figure is reported as primary.
notes.retailDepositsPct: Individuals deposits $330,413mm ÷ total deposits $982,440mm (Table 27, as at Oct 31, 2024, as originally reported in the FY2024 AIF). Note: BMO's FY2025 AIF later reclassified/restated this comparative to $320,767mm and introduced a new 'Deposits at FVTPL' line not broken out in the original FY2024 filing — the figure here uses the as-originally-disclosed FY2024 classification.
notes.wholesaleDepositsPct: (Banks $33,266mm + Businesses and governments $618,761mm) ÷ total deposits $982,440mm, as originally reported for FY2024.
notes.stableDepositsPct: Stable deposits $139M as a share of total retail and small-business deposits $301M ($139M stable + $162M less stable). Denominator is the retail and small-business book, so this bucket and less stable deposits sum to 100%.
notes.lessStableDepositsPct: Less stable deposits $162M as a share of total retail and small-business deposits $301M ($139M stable + $162M less stable). Denominator is the retail and small-business book, so this bucket and stable deposits sum to 100%.
notes.operationalDepositsPct: Operational deposits $153M as a share of total wholesale deposits $293M ($153M operational + $140M non-operational). Denominator is the wholesale book, so this bucket and non-operational deposits sum to 100%.
notes.nonOperationalDepositsPct: Non-operational deposits $140M as a share of total wholesale deposits $293M ($153M operational + $140M non-operational). Denominator is the wholesale book, so this bucket and operational deposits sum to 100%.
notes.irrbbEveSensitivityPct: BMO does not disclose the 6-scenario Basel/OSFI IRRBB1 template at the consolidated enterprise level (confirmed absent from BMO's and CIBC's OSFI Pillar 3 disclosures alike). Its Annual Report/AIF Market Risk section (Table 45, 'Structural Interest Rate Sensitivity', as at Oct 31, 2024) discloses only 2 of the 6 scenarios: an immediate parallel +100bp and -100bp shift, constant balance sheet, pre-tax C$. More adverse scenario (+100bp): Economic Value Sensitivity Total = -$1,483mm ÷ Tier 1 Capital $64,735mm (Table 30, CC1) = -2.29%. Computed ratio; BMO does not itself express EVE sensitivity as % of Tier 1 capital.
notes.irrbbNiiSensitivityPct: Most adverse (-100bp) 12-month NII sensitivity $-210M ÷ Tier 1 capital $64,735M = -0.32%. Re-based to % of Tier 1 capital (from the earlier % of annual NII) to match the cross-bank convention used by RBC/TD/CIBC/National.
notes.newMetricsSource: BMO 2024 Annual Report / Annual Information Form (Exhibit 99.2 to Form 40-F) — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/927971/000119312524271395/d878486dex992.htm

notes.roa: Disclosed by the issuer: 0.65% return on average assets, read from the supplementary financial information (page 7), in the column headed Q4 2024. Not computed.
notes.adjustedOperatingLeverage: Disclosed: +2.4% adjusted operating leverage, read from the issuer's Q2 2026 financial supplementary information (page 7) in the column headed Q4 2024. notes.rotce: Disclosed: 15.6% return on tangible common equity (reported basis, not the adjusted row), read from page 5 of the cited document in the column for Q4 2024. ROTCE is net income available to common shareholders over average common equity less goodwill and intangibles.

irrbbDisclosureNote: BMO discloses interest rate risk in the banking book every quarter, in the Structural (Non-Trading) Market Risk section of its Report to Shareholders (and Annual Report) under 'Structural Interest Rate Sensitivity'. It shows 2 of the 6 Basel shock scenarios — an immediate parallel +100bp and -100bp shift (rates floored at zero, constant balance sheet) — reporting both Economic Value Sensitivity (ΔEVE) and 12-month Earnings Sensitivity (ΔNII), split by Canada and the United States, pre-tax in C$ millions. BMO does not itself express these as a percentage of Tier 1 capital; the %-of-Tier-1 figures in this dataset are computed by dividing BMO's disclosed dollar sensitivities by its Tier 1 capital, matching the normalization used for the other banks.
